# Ayu

Ayu is a light theme built on a soft pastel palette that its recorded description ties to readability. Beyond the colours it makes small interface adjustments to spacing and typography. No dark variant, settings or installation detail is recorded beyond that.

![Ayu screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Ayu/HEAD/ayu2.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ayu"
    author: "bcdavasconcelos"
    repo:   "bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Ayu"
    slug:   "ayu"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ayu"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Ayu"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Ayu/HEAD/ayu2.png"

    modes:  ["light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a light Ayu theme with a soft pastel palette and high readability. Provide subtle UI tweaks for consistent spacing, clearer typography, and a calm, modern interface across Obsidian."
}
```
